label: For "Transaction Monitoring Alert Triage with LLM Agents": Auto-summarise and pre-dispose low-risk AML alerts with cited evidence so analysts spend time only on genuinely suspicious cases. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Golden set written by the same team that prompts the model.
